name: browserdefense
description: Browser-based IOC blocking with zero-knowledge forensics

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && pnpm run copy-static
scripts.build:enterprise: tsc && vite build --outDir dist-enterprise && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --outDir dist-enterprise && pnpm run copy-static:enterprise
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:enterprise
scripts.copy-static: cp manifest.json dist/ && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/ && cp src/popup/popup.css dist/ && cp src/options/options.html dist/ && cp src/options/options.css dist/ && mkdir -p dist/blocked && cp src/blocked/blocked.html dist/blocked/ && cp src/blocked/blocked.css dist/blocked/ && mkdir -p dist/dashboard && cp src/dashboard/dashboard.html dist/dashboard/ && cp src/dashboard/dashboard.css dist/dashboard/ && mkdir -p dist/icons && cp icons/*.png dist/icons/
scripts.copy-static:enterprise: cp manifest.enterprise.json dist-enterprise/manifest.json && cp src/popup/popup.html dist-enterprise/ && cp src/popup/popup.css dist-enterprise/ && cp src/options/options.html dist-enterprise/ && cp src/options/options.css dist-enterprise/ && mkdir -p dist-enterprise/blocked && cp src/blocked/blocked.html dist-enterprise/blocked/ && cp src/blocked/blocked.css dist-enterprise/blocked/ && mkdir -p dist-enterprise/dashboard && cp src/dashboard/dashboard.html dist-enterprise/dashboard/ && cp src/dashboard/dashboard.css dist-enterprise/dashboard/ && mkdir -p dist-enterprise/icons && cp icons/*.png dist-enterprise/icons/
scripts.package: pnpm run build:all && bash scripts/package-extension.sh && bash scripts/package-extension.sh enterprise
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build:all && pnpm test && pnpm run cli:build && pnpm run cli:test && pnpm run test:manifest
